cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. The Umutangakori facts come from an OBR source of November 2023; E-KORI, its successor, was still being implemented in January 2026.
cells.note: An OBR source of 28 November 2023 says large and medium taxpayers file returns and pay taxes online on the Umutangakori portal, in use since August 2023 (BDI-002, BDI-003). Nothing makes online filing mandatory or puts its share at half, so not 5.
